reviews.title: Great RAM and awesome RGB
reviews.comment: I lucked out a got it before the RAM-Armageddon. The RAM works as should no issues specially the specs I was looking for 32GB at CL30. Super solid if you can get your hands on.
reviews.author: BRIAN NICASIO

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.comment: Great DDR5 Ram. Its fast as long as you remember to activate XMP or EXPO for performance. It has RGB functionality. You can game and not worry. I got it for $159.99
reviews.author: Arkade

reviews.title: Great SKHynix RAM for the price
reviews.comment: I was able to run 6000 CL26 in 1:1 on my AMD 9950X3D as well as 8000 CL34 in 2:1 mode. Very good cooling and looks great. I would buy Lexar again in a heartbeat. Great Hynix A-die kit for the price...just as good as my higher-priced G.Skill Trident Z Neo 6000 CL28 kit.
reviews.author: RickY

reviews.title: Good ram kit even on intel with tight timings
reviews.comment: It works but I got sent already opened or refurbished one… when I paid for a new one at full. Follow up from my previous review: Customer service is great compensated for the damaged packaging
reviews.author: Sathursan Samson
